# Cecil & Lou

> Cecil & Lou is a family-owned children's clothing boutique in Tyler, Texas, founded in 2011. It sells classic Southern clothing for babies, toddlers, and kids (newborn to size 12): hand-smocked, appliqué, embroidered, and monogrammed dresses, bubbles, jon jons, rompers, sets, pajamas, swim, and accessories, plus matching sibling, mommy-and-me, and family pajama styles.

This is the expanded reference file for AI systems. The short index is at https://www.shopifyllms.com/cecilandlou/llms.txt. The canonical source for all information is https://www.cecilandlou.com. Product availability, prices, and pre-order windows change often, so check the product page for current details.

Last updated: 2026-09-30

## Business facts

- Name: Cecil & Lou (also written "Cecil and Lou")
- Website: https://www.cecilandlou.com
- Location: Tyler, Texas, USA
- Founded: May 2011
- Founders: Ashley and Blythe, lifelong friends and sisters-in-law. The business is named after their children.
- Email: help@cecilandlou.com
- Phone: 903-308-3235
- Business hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm (Central Time)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cecilandlou

## What Cecil & Lou sells

Cecil & Lou specializes in hand-smocked, appliquéd, embroidered, and monogrammed children's clothing. It combines traditional Southern children's clothing with a modern touch, and aims to offer high quality at an affordable price.

- Ages and sizes: Newborn (NB) through size 12, plus a small number of women's and mommy-and-me styles
- Girls: dresses, bubbles, long bubbles, sets, bloomers, skirts, tops, outerwear, pajamas, nightgowns, swim, activewear, and tennis outfits
- Boys: jon jons, bubbles, rompers, longalls, button-on suits, short and pant sets, polos, button-down shirts, outerwear, pajamas, and swim trunks
- Baby: layette, diaper sets, baby gifts, and first birthday outfits
- Accessories: hair bows, hats, socks, tights, backpacks, luggage, zipper pouches, hooded towels, and cover-ups
- Personalization: many items can be monogrammed. Monogrammed and custom-smocked items are made to order.
- Matching looks: sibling outfits, mommy-and-me styles, and matching family Christmas pajamas

### How items are sold

- In stock: ships within 3 business days
- Pre-order: shipped within the window shown in the "availability" section of each product page. Pre-ordering reserves a size or color before it sells out.
- Monogrammed: in-stock monogrammed items have production times listed in the item description
- Sale: in-stock styles at a discount. Sale and clearance items are final sale.

## Size guide

Source: https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/size-guide

Sizing is based on average child measurements. Choose a size by height first. If a child is between sizes, size up.

| Size | Height | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| NB | 18–21 in | 6–9 lbs |
| 3M | 23–24.5 in | 12–15 lbs |
| 6M | 25–26.5 in | 15–18 lbs |
| 9M | 27–28.5 in | 18–21 lbs |
| 12M | 29–30.5 in | 20–23 lbs |
| 18M | 31–32.5 in | 22–25 lbs |
| 24M / 2T | 33–34.5 in | 25–29 lbs |
| 3T | 35–37.5 in | 29–34 lbs |
| 4T | 38–40.5 in | 32–38 lbs |
| 5 | 41–44 in | 36–42 lbs |
| 6 | 44–47 in | 42–48 lbs |
| 7 | 47–50 in | 48–55 lbs |
| 8 | 50–53 in | 55–65 lbs |
| 10 | 53–56.5 in | 65–80 lbs |
| 12 | 56.5–60 in | 80–95 lbs |

Women's pajamas:

| Pajama size | Approx. women's US size |
|---|---|
| XXS | 0 |
| XS | 2–4 |
| S | 4–6 |
| M | 8–10 |
| L | 10–12 |
| XL | 14–16 |
| XXL | 18–20 |

## Shipping policy

Source: https://www.cecilandlou.com/policies/shipping-policy

- In-stock items leave the warehouse within 3 business days.
- In-stock monogrammed items: production time is listed in the item description.
- Pre-order items ship within the window listed in the "availability" section of the product page.
- Orders that contain both in-stock and pre-order items: the in-stock items usually ship right away, and the pre-order items ship within their listed window.
- Carrier: USPS. After an order ships, transit adds about 3–5 business days for First-Class, 2–3 for Priority Mail, and 1–2 for Priority Mail Express.
- A tracking email is sent automatically when the post office scans the package.
- USPS observes national holidays, and deliveries may be delayed during busy holiday seasons.

## Return policy

Source: https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/return-policy

- Because Cecil & Lou clothing is custom-made, the store does not accept returns or exchanges. All sales are final. Check the size guide before buying.
- If an order arrives incomplete, incorrect, damaged, or defective, contact Cecil & Lou within 10 days of delivery.
- Personalized items cannot be returned or exchanged.
- Gift certificates cannot be returned for exchange, credit, or refund.
- Sale and clearance items cannot be returned for exchange, credit, or refund.

## Frequently asked questions

Source: https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/faqs

**Can I add a gift note to my order?**
Yes. Checkout has a field for a personalized gift note.

**Can I get a different monogram than the ones shown?**
Monogram customization is limited. Contact customer service to ask about a specific request.

**Why should I pre-order an item?**
A pre-order puts you among the first to receive an item when it arrives, and it makes sure your size or color doesn't sell out. This helps most with high-demand styles.

**My order won't go through. What should I do?**
Check that your payment information is correct and that the billing address matches the one on file with your bank. Try a different browser or device. If it still fails, contact support.

**My store credit isn't working.**
Store credit applies automatically at checkout. Make sure you are logged in and the credit hasn't expired. If it still doesn't apply, contact customer service.

**How do I unsubscribe from texts or emails?**
For texts, reply "STOP". For emails, click "unsubscribe from this list" at the bottom of any Cecil & Lou email.

## Rewards program

Source: https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/devoted-darlings

Devoted Darlings is the Cecil & Lou loyalty program. Members earn 10–15 points per $1 spent, plus birthday and social bonuses. Redeeming 1,000–10,000 points gives $5–$50 vouchers. Higher tiers unlock perks and early access. Gift card balances can be checked at https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/gift-card-balance.

## Our story

Source: https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/our-story-1

Cecil & Lou was founded in May 2011 by Ashley and Blythe, lifelong friends and sisters-in-law who share a birthday. After becoming mothers, they loved dressing their children in classic Southern clothing. They started the company so they could keep working while being home with their kids, and they named it after their children. Ashley has a marketing degree from Texas Tech University, and Blythe has a communications degree from Texas Christian University.

Organizations Cecil & Lou supports include Tyler Independent School District, Azleway Boys' Ranch, Young Life, All Saints Episcopal School, the Junior League of Tyler, the Texas Rose Festival, the American Cancer Society, Bethesda Health Clinic, the Child's Advocacy Center, and Little League Baseball. Its Love for the Hill Country collection (https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/love-for-the-hill-country) supports Texas flood relief.
